title: forge-ci artifacts.yml
description: Declarative release plan for a repository. See https://github.com/diggsweden/forge-ci/blob/main/docs/artifacts-reference.md.

distro-packages.description: The presence of this block publishes every .deb, .rpm and .apk file of the release to the forge's own Debian, RPM and Alpine package registries, beside the release; an empty block publishes with the default places. The published file is the release's file, unchanged. Supported by the Forgejo release; the GitLab and GitHub releases refuse it. See https://github.com/diggsweden/forge-ci/blob/main/docs/artifacts-reference.md#distro-packages-section.

distribution.description: Distribution .deb files are published under. Default: stable.

component.description: Component .deb files are published under. Default: main.

group.description: Group, the repository of the RPM registry, .rpm files are published to; steps joined by a slash, as in rocky/el9. Default: stable.

branch.description: Branch .apk files are published under. Default: stable.

repository.description: Repository .apk files are published under. Default: main.

git-signing.description: Backend for signing the release commit and tag (git objects), independent of the artifact `sign` backend. See https://github.com/diggsweden/forge-ci/blob/main/docs/verification.md#choosing-a-method.

method.description: gpg (default; imports $RELEASE_GPG_PRIVATE_KEY) or ssh (git-native SSH signing via $SSH_SIGNING_KEY, no OpenPGP key on the runner, verified against .forge-ci/allowed_signers).

sign.description: Signing backend for `release sign` and `release sbom-zip --sign`. See https://github.com/diggsweden/forge-ci/blob/main/docs/verification.md#signing-methods-for-release-artifacts.

method.description: gpg (default; uses $GPG_PRIVATE_KEY), sigstore (keyless cosign + OIDC), or kms (cosign + key).

files-method.description: Sign the release files with gpg while method (sigstore or kms) signs the container images. Omitted, method signs both. Supported by the GitHub release; the GitLab and Forgejo releases refuse it.

key.description: cosign --key reference for method=kms. Allowed schemes: awskms://, gcpkms://, azurekms://, hashivault://, pkcs11:, file: (intentionally explicit prefix for local key files). Other schemes are rejected as a security-hardening measure.

oidc-issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL for method=sigstore (default: auto-detected — GitHub Actions / GitLab / $CI_SERVER_URL). Must be HTTPS.

transparency.description: Whether cosign publishes signatures to the permanent public Sigstore transparency log (Rekor). Omission defaults to public for public repositories; private or unknown visibility requires explicit public consent. The log carries the artifact's SHA-256, signature, public key and timestamp, not its contents or filename. none makes no entry and is valid only for method=kms; gpg has no log and keyless sigstore requires one. Verifying an unlogged signature needs --insecure-ignore-tlog.

projectType.description: Ecosystem identifier. For `go` and `cargo`, config.build-mode selects the pipeline shape (artifact-first|container-first; omitted defaults to artifact-first). Python is reserved as a future placeholder and is rejected until build/publish support exists.

sboms.description: Enum or comma-list. Valid: all, none, build, analyzed-artifact, analyzed-container, or a comma-separated subset.

require-authorization.description: When true, the release request must be signed by a key listed in .forge-ci/allowed_signers (SSH) or .forge-ci/allowed_gpg_keys.asc (GPG). Maven Central requires this authorization regardless of this setting.

config.description: Per-ecosystem options. Schema varies by project-type — see https://github.com/diggsweden/forge-ci/blob/main/docs/artifacts-reference.md for the field list of each ecosystem.

from.description: Artifact names this container consumes (matching artifacts[].name).

image-name.description: Image repository in place of the one derived from the repository and name: a path under the registry (owner/app) or a full repository with its own registry. Containers that share one are tag variants and must differ by tag-suffix.

tag-suffix.description: Suffix after the release tag, e.g. -distroless for v1.2.3-distroless. Default: none.

enable-slsa.description: Generate SLSA build provenance for this container. Default: true. Set false to disable on a debug/testing container that shouldn't carry provenance.

scan-severity.description: Per-container blocking threshold of the vulnerability scan: a finding at this level or above with a fixed package blocks the publish; an unfixed CRITICAL blocks unless .trivyignore.yaml approves it. A level or a comma-list whose least severe entry counts ('CRITICAL,HIGH' blocks at HIGH). Default 'CRITICAL'. HIGH findings are always reported, blocking or not.

build-secrets.description: Names of BuildKit secrets to forward into the Containerfile build as `--mount=type=secret,id=<lowercased-name>` mounts. Values come from the FORGE_CI_BUILD_SECRETS_JSON envelope packed by the caller workflow; the publish-container materialize step writes them to mode-0600 tmpfiles for the duration of the build. Unlike build-args, these values are NEVER recorded in SLSA provenance attestations — use this for any secret consumed at build time (private package tokens, build-time API keys). See https://github.com/diggsweden/forge-ci/blob/main/docs/artifacts-reference.md for the full caller recipe.

target.description: Containerfile stage that exposes the binary (typically a `FROM scratch` export-binary stage).

names.description: Expected binary filenames; the build fails if any are missing.

paths.description: Regular executable paths in the retained runtime image, copied without rebuilding. Output basenames must be unique. Mutually exclusive with target and names.
